label: Flat tax: deadline to apply for 19% monthly withholding
unit: day of the month following the first day of work in Korea
appliesTo: Foreign employees wanting 19% withheld from payroll rather than settled later
why: A short window that opens once, at the busiest possible moment — the first weeks of a new job in a new country. Missing it does not forfeit the election itself, which is the part people panic about, but it does change cash flow for a whole year.

history.source: Enforcement Decree of the Restriction of Special Taxation Act
history.note: The application for flat-rate withholding is filed by the 10th day of the month following the month containing the day work was first provided in Korea, submitted through the employer as withholding agent to the head of the competent tax office. Missing it does not lose the special provision — the final election is made separately at year-end settlement or on the annual return.
